result.title: FinVerify: A Verification Framework for Financial Agents
result.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
result.summary: Financial agents produce numerical claims that can be wrong even when their calculations execute correctly, due to mismatched reporting periods, unsupported sources, incompatible units, or incorrect financial definitions. We introduce FinVerify, an evidence-grounded framework for verifying financial agents' numerical claims. Based on an analysis of 190 incorrect trajectories from the Agent Finance Reasoning dataset, we define five error categories--temporal integrity, source fidelity, comparability, accounting integrity, and financial-model fidelity--and operationalize them as verification protocols. An LLM structures claims and supporting evidence, while deterministic validators check financial requirements; when authoritative formulas are available, Z3 checks consistency with grounded inputs. FinVerify accepts only if all applicable checks pass, rejects proven violations, and abstains when evidence is insufficient. We evaluate the framework against a Direct baseline and an LLM judge across five fixed-candidate benchmarks. On Agent Finance Reasoning, accepted-claim precision increases from 56.4% for the LLM judge to 76.7% at 81.2% coverage. On XBRLFiling, FinVerify achieves 99.8% accepted-claim precision and 97.0% decision accuracy; on FinanceBench-67, it reaches 87.9% accepted-claim precision versus 69.7% for the judge. Improvements are smaller on FinQA and TAT-QA, where authoritative evidence is limited. These results suggest that explicit, evidence-backed verification can improve financial-agent reliability while exposing trade-offs between correctness, false rejection, and abstention.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 FinVerify，一个面向金融 agent 数值主张的「证据接地」验证框架：先基于 190 条错误轨迹归纳五类错误，再由 LLM 结构化主张与支撑证据、确定性校验器检查财务要求、必要时用 Z3 校验公式一致性，最后按「接受／拒绝／证据不足弃权」三态裁决。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「LLM 结构化证据＋确定性校验器＋证据不足即弃权」的分工式验证与三态决策，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 结论的证据核验、弃权/停止判据，以及验证成本与覆盖率权衡；但任务领域为金融文本，与视觉推理的迁移需自行判断。
